summaryEn: Teaches you to build an unreal comparison both with and without a conjunction.
Teaches you to use the formal concessive conjunctions with the right case and word order.
Teaches you to set up a hypothesis and to argue about what would follow from it.
Teaches you to describe belonging with concessive clauses that cut both ways.
Teaches you to separate individual from systemic responsibility in nominal language.
Teaches you to argue about a past that never happened, with unreal conditions.
Teaches you to question what we attribute to machines, with unreal comparison.
Teaches you to debate the load between generations in concessive and genitive language.
Teaches you to define the limits with the language of reference that draws distinctions.
Teaches you to design a future that has not been built, in the unreal mood.
Teaches you to recognise the sentences where what is said is the opposite of what is meant.
Teaches you to notice where a joke turns into a hurt, and to take it back.
Teaches you to spot wordplay on double meanings and to see the limit of translation.
Teaches you to talk about regional stereotypes with a wink and without a sweeping judgement.
Teaches you a way of listening that aims to understand regional differences.

titleEn: The art of switching to du
summaryEn: Teaches you to offer the informal du politely, and to decline it.
Teaches you to pay a compliment in the right measure and convincingly.
Teaches you to rescue the situation with idioms after you have put your foot in it.
Teaches you to recognise dry humour and to talk about humour itself.
Teaches you to name a cultural difference without judging it.
Teaches you the language of fast decisions in a crisis, with function verb phrases.
Teaches you to offer a stopgap when the plan breaks and to state its limits honestly.
Teaches you to carry across in sense what cannot be carried across word for word.
Teaches you to bring every rhetorical tool together in a single speech.
Teaches you to close a negotiation in the diplomatic subjunctive.
Teaches you to discuss the exam format and the marking criteria in academic language.
Teaches you to pass on your own path through learning to someone else.
Teaches you to describe being bilingual through unreal comparisons.
Teaches you to discuss language change apart from the rhetoric of decline.
Teaches you to weigh the road travelled in metaphors, and closes the level.
